name: Kbd
summary: Small label for a key or shortcut, like ⌘K or Esc. Used in Search input and Command menu.
use: Show shortcuts in search fields, menus and help text.
avoid: As a button: Kbd is only a hint.
a11y: Native <kbd>. Purely decorative hints (next to a label that already names the action) can be aria-hidden.
content: Use ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl on Windows if you know the platform.
dont: Show shortcuts that do not work.
